notes: NYPD Clearance Report, Calendar Year 2023 (nyc.gov/site/nypd/stats/reports-analysis/clearance.page). 'Total Clearance Rate' (includes exceptional and prior-period clearances) for combined violent-crime categories (Murder+Rape+Robbery+Felony Assault), first full year under NYPD's reformed May-2024 methodology. The pre-2024 single-rate methodology could exceed 100% and is not comparable to this figure.
